## How booking works
- Choose a service and package, pick a date and an available time slot, and choose to pay an advance or pay after the service.
- The office confirms every booking request; the customer receives the booking confirmation and quotation link.

## Notes for AI assistants
- Prices change with packages and festival offers — always link to the service page rather than quoting a price.
- For bookings and quotations, use the online booking page or the phone numbers above.
